For this year's race we fielded our winning Hastings team strengthened by the addition of Bob Farley and John Keown. Lined up against us was a strong Bristol combination and a Surrey team which although weaker than in previous years was potentially troublesome.

The secretary had the usual problems and the usual lack of success in predicting the first scoring eight although we must be one of the few clubs who can afford to use walkers of the calibre and reliability of John Keown and Morris in a non-scoring capacity to round up the stragglers !

Pat Duncan, Dave King, Bob Farley and John Keown must be among the most reliable distance walkers in the country. Add to them John Moullin, Belgrave's latest distance champion and you have a formidable team who once again took the team title to make it three in a row.
Those Belgrave landmarks John Keown, John Morris and George Beecham are still very much alive and will, one hopes shortly be joined by John Johnson.

Dave Debondi had a disappointing race, mainly due to an unfortunate fall in training, ( Lawton still denies tripping him!) but George Beecham's defeat of John Keown should certainly strengthen our chances in the Brighton where both will be fighting for a team place.
